definitions.gloss: joining a club, entering a school club
definitions.explanation: Becoming a member of a club activity (部活動) at school, typically in middle school or high school. A fundamental part of Japanese school life.

examples.japanese: テニス{部|ぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}した。
{入部|にゅうぶ}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit a club membership form.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}に{入|はい}ったら{何|なん}の{部|ぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}するか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I can't decide which club to join when I start middle school.

notes:
Specifically refers to school club activities ({部活|ぶかつ}). In Japanese schools, students typically choose a club to join at the start of the school year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{入部|にゅうぶ}{届|とどけ} (club membership application form)
・{入部|にゅうぶ}{希望|きぼう} (desire to join a club)
・{入部|にゅうぶ}テスト (tryout for joining a club)
・～{部|ぶ}に{入部|にゅうぶ}する (join the ~ club)

ANTONYM:
・{退部|たいぶ}: quitting a club

RELATED:
・{入会|にゅうかい}: joining an organization (broader — gyms, associations, etc.)
・{入団|にゅうだん}: joining a team or troupe (sports teams, theater groups)
